frequency_question: What proportion of highly contested regulatory agency head nominees successfully achieve a Senate floor confirmation vote resulting in approval within the standard legislative time frame?
membership_rule: Includes cabinet-level or major regulatory agency heads (FDA, EPA, CDC, CMS) facing organized opposition from the minority party or moderate swing senators. Excludes routine, uncontested confirmations.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named prominent recent FDA confirmation battles; historical baseline shows high ultimate confirmation rates for executive nominees once floor votes occur, despite initial delays.
known_gaps: Excludes nominees withdrawn prior to committee vote due to insurmountable opposition.
skeleton: Contested FDA nominations over four administrations
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 historical contested floor votes reaching confirmation
validity_reason: Valid through the current political administration's term and Senate polarization dynamics.
